purpose: Test exact shared-prefix reuse in the DINO-WM Wall CEM planner while preserving candidate ranking and selected first action.

scope.checkpoint: official wall_single checkpoint selected by the reproduction run; record the concrete checkpoint identifier in each result manifest

fixed_settings.objective: mean MSE on the final predicted visual embedding plus alpha times mean MSE on the final predicted proprio embedding

baseline.definition: Recompute encode_obs, action encoding, rollout, and objective for every candidate population and CEM iteration.

iteration_cache.definition: Within one planner call, compute the observation prefix for the first CEM iteration and reuse it in later CEM iterations; keep every action-conditioned suffix and objective computation unchanged.

factorized_cache.definition: Within one planner call, compute encode_obs once per real observation and broadcast the resulting prefix to the 300 candidate suffix evaluations; keep every action-conditioned suffix and objective computation unchanged.

boundary.action_independence_basis: structural input separation: encode_obs consumes only transformed observation visual/proprio tensors; action enters through encode_act after this boundary
boundary.jacobian_search: not required for this frozen first implementation; do not substitute a local-Jacobian-only certificate for the structural boundary

mechanism_gate.unit: one fixed observation, CEM iteration, and candidate population
mechanism_gate.population_reuse: The exact same pre-generated candidate tensors and candidate population seed must be used by all three paths for each record.

paths.prefix_and_rollout: Each is an object with equal_to_baseline (boolean), shape (array), dtype (string), and device (string). The comparison must be the bitwise tensor equality used by the implementation; no tolerance is accepted.
paths.decision_values: objective has exactly 300 finite numeric values; full_order is a permutation of 0..299; topk30 has exactly 30 indices and equals full_order[:30]; mu, sigma, and first_action are JSON numeric arrays. Cached-path values must equal baseline values exactly after JSON parsing.
paths.canary: For each cached path, canary.executed=true and canary.fallback_triggered=false. A valid cache record must not silently fall back.

record_schema.fail_fast: Any cached-path first_action mismatch, or any missing/false required comparison, fails the mechanism gate. A single failing population is sufficient for failure.

negative_controls.forbidden_legacy_control: randomized-mask, randomized_mask, or all-zero-mask permutation control
negative_controls.required_values: All three required fields are true for both controls. downstream_mismatch means at least one candidate objective, complete order, or selected first action differs from the valid baseline under the deliberately corrupted control.
negative_controls.purpose: Show that the canary/control catches an unsafe boundary or an observation-identity collision; these controls are not evidence for the valid cache path.

mechanism_gate.pass_rule: PASS only when every record has the three paths, all eight required comparisons agree exactly, every cached canary is executed without fallback, and both negative controls report the required mismatch.

system_gate.technical_repeats_note: Technical repeats are measurement repeats, not independent observations.
system_gate.pairing: Each planner_call_id must contain the same technical_repeat labels for all three paths.
system_gate.timing_boundary: CEMPlanner.plan entry through returned first action
system_gate.device_synchronization: synchronize immediately before starting and immediately after stopping each timed call
system_gate.latency_statistic: For each planner call and path, take the median technical-repeat latency; report the median of paired per-call reductions, reduction = 1 - median(cache_latency)/median(baseline_latency).

latency_gate.rule: For both cache paths, paired median reduction must be at least 0.20.

system_gate.memory_statistic: For each planner call and path, take the maximum technical-repeat peak_memory_mib; compare the maximum cached-to-baseline ratio across calls.

memory_gate.rule: For both cache paths, maximum peak-memory ratio must be at most 1.10.

system_gate.pass_rule: PASS only when metadata, pairing, finite positive timings, both latency reductions, and both memory ratios satisfy the frozen rules.

closed_loop_gate.authorization: Run and verify only after mechanism_gate and system_gate pass.
closed_loop_gate.unit: case and MPC round from identical initial state, goal, checkpoint, preprocessing, seed, and candidate tensors
closed_loop_gate.pass_rule: For every case and MPC round, both cache paths must have exactly the same first_action and success as baseline. Any first-action mismatch fails.

result_files.mechanism: JSONL; one record per fixed population
result_files.system: JSON summary containing the records array and timing metadata
result_files.closed_loop: JSONL; only produced after the two pre-gates pass

prohibited: Do not alter candidate tensors, random seeds, checkpoint, objective, tie-breaking, or action-conditioned suffix between paths.
Do not report approximate equality as exact equality.
Do not use a randomized-mask or all-zero-mask permutation control.
Do not use hashes as a substitute for the recorded comparisons.
Do not claim closed-loop validation when the pre-gates have not passed.
